Weekends: The waterfall remains crowded during weekends, so plan your visit on weekdays if you prefer a quieter experience.
Safety Precautions: Wear sturdy footwear as the area around the waterfall can be slippery, especially during the rainy season. Exercise caution while trekking and bathing in the water.
Carry Essentials: Bring essentials like water, snacks, and insect repellent, as there are limited facilities around the waterfall.
